elements.description:
How one model generates: its supported parameters with plain explanations, presets, feedback on incompatible
settings and what differs from the defaults.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the group's name

properties.name: model
properties.description: The model the settings are for; unset shows every parameter

properties.name: value
properties.description: The values the person set, by parameter id; missing ones are the defaults. Changed by the user unless tc-value-change is prevented

properties.name: parameters
properties.default: [ { id: "temperature", label: "Temperature", kind: "range", min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.1, default: 1, ends: ["Focused", "Varied"], description: "How much the wording varies between answers. Lower sticks to the likeliest words; higher tries less likely ones.", }, { id: "topP", label: "Top-p", kind: "range", min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.05, default: 1, description: "Which words are in the running: only the likeliest ones that add up to this share. Lower is more predictable.", }, { id: "maxOutputTokens", label: "Output length", kind: "range", min: 256, max: 16384, step: 256, default: 4096, unit: "tokens", description: "The longest an answer can be. An answer that reaches it stops mid-sentence.", }, { id: "reasoningEffort", label: "Reasoning effort", kind: "choice", default: "medium", options: [ { value: "low", label: "Low" }, { value: "medium", label: "Medium" }, { value: "high", label: "High" }, ], description: "How much work the model does before it answers. More is slower and costs more. Only the answer comes back – its working isn't shown or kept.", }, ]
properties.description: Every parameter the app knows; only those the model supports are shown

properties.name: presets
properties.default: [ { id: "precise", label: "Precise", description: "Nearly the same answer every time – for extraction, classification and facts", values: { temperature: 0.2, reasoningEffort: "high" } }, { id: "balanced", label: "Balanced", description: "Natural wording with few surprises – a good default for conversation", values: { temperature: 0.7, reasoningEffort: "medium" } }, { id: "creative", label: "Creative", description: "More varied wording and ideas – for drafts and brainstorming", values: { temperature: 1.2, reasoningEffort: "low" } }, ]
properties.description: Named sets of values; a preset is picked when the shown values match it

properties.name: conflicts
properties.default: [ { params: ["temperature", "topP"], message: "Temperature and top-p both change how varied answers are. Move one and leave the other at its default." }, ]
properties.description: Parameters that shouldn't all move from their defaults at once, with what to say when they do

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the supported values as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the settings out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: supported
properties.description: The parameters the model supports, in the order `parameters` lists them

properties.name: resolved
properties.description: Every supported value, the defaults filled in

properties.name: changes
properties.description: The supported parameters whose value differs from the default

properties.name: preset
properties.description: The preset the shown values match, or null for custom values

properties.name: issues
properties.description: What to fix: conflicting changes, then values the model ignores

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A value changed ({ value: ModelSettingsValue, changed: string[] }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

methods.name: defaultOf
methods.description: A parameter's default for this model

functions.name: formatModelParam
functions.signature: formatModelParam(p: ModelParam, v: ModelParamValue | undefined): string
functions.description: A parameter's value as text: "0.7", "4,096 tokens", "High"

props.name: title
props.description: Shown at the top; names the group

props.name: value
props.description: The values the person set, by parameter id (controlled); missing ones are the model's defaults

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the next values and the ids that changed
